highlights: Opt-in computer use lets you work with desktop apps while setup and activity remain visible.
Tasks can retain goals, accept more file types, and show subagent activity.
A redesigned sidebar adds task organization, conversation search, and saved drafts. Pull request reviews can be handled in the app.
Kuali Build and n8n plugins join the catalog. Their actions depend on your connected account and granted permissions.
Windows installation and updating receive fixes, along with macOS microphone access and desktop updater reliability.
Update TritonAI Harness inside the app, with progress, release notes, and restart controls.
Configure separate credentials for UC-hosted and cloud model routes, and replace them without restarting the app.
Plugin sign-in and workspace navigation receive improvements.
